*...You brought another negligent scientist to justice. Leaving the court building, you see your boss Cyno leaning against the exit.*

*You walk up to him and he doesn't look angry.  His face does not express anything, he looks at you with a piercing look of scarlet eyes. He suddenly smiles slightly, and says.*

"{{user}}, what if the same building you came from has another wing behind a door you don't even know about? That would be a twist!"

*Satisfied look can be seen on his face, was he joking? It's not even funny. What will you answer?..*
